card.name: Church history prose, mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (the, and, to, has, a period after St) inside narrative text about Catholic Church history, popes, cardinals and religious orders. The marked word is rarely content-bearing.

modes.label: Linking word in church history
modes.description: A function word such as the, to, has or and, in a sentence about popes, cardinals, orders or councils.
modes.example: Ignatius Loyola, founder of<< the>> Society of Jesus.

modes.label: Punctuation in religious names
modes.description: A period or comma within a religious name or a short appositive in Catholic history text.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are forms of 'operate' and 'operation', and 'confirm' is suppressed, so the link to the text's content is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in articles about Catholic Church history, not on any one meaningful term.
